title: AIR Capability Ecology Architect Method Pack
description: Reusable evidence-gated method for reconstructing the complete relevant capability envelope, translating human-oriented knowledge frameworks into bounded machine-native requirements, compiling knowledge-to-execution paths and synthetic benchmarks, applying risk and proportionality, constructing candidate Detailed Domain Packages, and selecting the smallest sufficient operative capability set for compilation into the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.

source_function_preserved: establish project and task execution envelopes
select the smallest sufficient operative set

authority_boundary.operative_use_rule: This Method Pack may shape a task-local AIR_ARTIFACT.method only after package integrity and compatibility review, explicit selection, required approval, and compilation into or explicit reference by the sole bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT.
authority_boundary.domain_truth_rule: The Registry owns taxonomy, template and fixture authority; approved versioned Domain Packages remain reusable declarative domain sources of truth; the Architect and this Method Pack compile task-scoped candidates and may not replace them.

source_adapters_and_external_corpora.non_fabrication_rule: Do not treat referenced adapters, occupational corpora, coverage reports, standards or external data as present, current, complete or validated unless supplied and verified.

purpose: Provide a portable, evidence-gated and handoff-safe procedure for converting a partial task request and available sources into a complete relevant capability envelope, bounded domain knowledge-processing obligations, a benchmarkable knowledge-to-execution path, and the smallest sufficient task-local capability selection without transferring human status or authority.

use_when: a task may require domain knowledge beyond documentation lookup and literal procedure following
a synthetic role or execution benchmark must be constructed or materially amended
a human occupational, professional, curriculum, competency, qualification or practitioner framework must be translated
a new or amended Detailed Domain Package candidate is needed
a cross-domain or emerging-domain task requires capability-envelope reconstruction
risk, consequence, reversibility or maturity materially changes the sufficient capability set
recurrence, portability, evidence gates or handoff safety justify a reusable Method Pack
do_not_use_when: a small bounded operation is adequately handled by one AIR_EXECUTOR without material state, evidence or handoff burden
the requested action is outside the bound Orbit 0 task and no explicit rescope has occurred
required source rights, authority, safety or integrity gates prohibit the action
the user requests direct use of a protected human title, licence, credential or institutional authority as machine identity
scope.scope_boundary: The Method Pack constructs and validates candidates. Final task approval, rejection, rescope, mutation or release remains governed by the bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT, AIR_GATE, user approvals and applicable authority gates.

required: bound Orbit 0 AIR_ARTIFACT identity, task key, active step and acceptance criteria
current source set and source-rights state
risk, consequence, reversibility, maturity and jurisdiction signals when material
validated Capability Ecology components required by the active branch
existing approved Domain Packages or explicit unknown/emerging-domain state
required user approvals and unresolved required-input requests
conditional: human role, competency, curriculum, certification, qualification, practice or occupational frameworks
official documentation, standards, verified guides and best-practice sources
practitioner evidence, case studies, incident reports, postmortems or representative task corpus
tools, connectors, repositories, credentials, datasets or operator actions
golden and negative fixtures for Detailed Domain Package construction
prior method execution state and handoff card
regulatory or governance test-evidence obligation and required evidence class when material
test definitions, commands, environment, inputs, logs, fixtures and review records available for the active run
prohibited_as_sufficient_evidence: assistant memory or previous narrative summary
official documentation without applicability and result evaluation
unsourced simulated expertise or invented tacit knowledge
user acknowledgement as universal liability transfer
method instructions as proof that execution occurred

knowledge dimensions and required cognitive depth
unresolved gaps and exact required-input requests
benchmark or fixture result when applicable
test-evidence mode and recommendation state when testing is material
test-evidence class, evidence references, reproducibility limits and rerun requirement when applicable
regulatory evidence requirement state when Governance identifies an obligation
outputs.non_authority_rule: Candidate output does not become operative merely because this method produced it.

required_for: Domain Package template and fixture validation

method_execution_contract.completion_rule: A method step cannot become COMPLETE without its declared evidence_to_advance unless an explicit permitted waiver is recorded. The whole method cannot become COMPLETE while a required branch step is BLOCKED, REVIEW, FAILED, INVALIDATED or stale.
method_execution_contract.gate_precedence: AIR_GATE is stricter when AIR_GATE and method_step_gate disagree.
method_execution_contract.execution_proof_boundary: Method execution state is a governance record, not backend proof, tool proof, external outcome proof or professional competence proof.

knowledge_processing_contract.selection_rule: Select and justify the minimum cognitive depth that can correctly complete and evaluate the active task. CREATE may be conditional, prohibited or human-gated.
knowledge_processing_contract.lookup_baseline_rule: Official documentation, verified guides and best practices are necessary when applicable but are not sufficient for method completion without comprehension, applicability, exception, judgment, adaptation and result-evaluation evidence.
knowledge_processing_contract.experience_boundary: Only sourced, attributed and bounded outputs of human experience may be represented. The model must not claim human experience or invent tacit knowledge.

knowledge_to_execution_path_contract.approval_boundary: The method may validate structural completeness of a candidate path. Final APPROVE requires the bound artifact benchmark and observable evidence that each required stage met its completion criteria.

registry_only: taxonomy, template, fixture or approved Domain Package index inspection when no coupled translation, construction, mutation or manifest validation is required
translator_only: translation analysis when validated Registry and Architect context is already available and no package mutation or manifest validation is required
method_pack_only: method schema inspection when execution is not requested and dependencies are not being asserted as complete

complete_package_required_cases: synthetic-role construction using coupled Registry, Translator, Architect and Method behavior
Detailed Domain Package construction, amendment, evaluation or promotion
required_input_acquisition_contract.request_rule: Check current session and validated package state first; name the smallest exact known requirement; state why it is needed and whether work is blocked, provisional or degraded; name real alternatives and a safe fallback; request the upload or action; validate after receipt.
required_input_acquisition_contract.identity_unresolved_rule: When exact identity is not established by current source truth or a validated manifest, name the logical capability role and ask the smallest resolving question rather than inventing a filename or package.
required_input_acquisition_contract.no_repeat_rule: Do not request a current compatible input already available. Re-request only for absence, staleness, mismatch, incompleteness, inaccessibility or supersession.
required_input_acquisition_contract.receipt_boundary: Receipt establishes availability only. Validate identity, version, hash, freshness, completeness, source rights, compatibility and task fit before reliance.

test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.mode_effect: Evidence packaging and retention for subsequent authorized test, validation, benchmark-evaluation and representative-task runs only.
summary_only_behavior: report decision, scoped counts, test or evaluation classes, material failures, claim boundary and available evidence references
state when the summary alone is not reproducible
do not generate or print full suites, complete logs, all fixtures or per-test evidence merely to prove testing occurred
full_test_evidence_outputs: executable test suite or disclosed test definitions
test-run manifest with command, working directory, runtime, environment, exact input identities and hashes, reliable timestamps and exit code
per-test results with identifier, requirement, class, inputs, expected state, observed state, decision, failure reason and evidence references
raw execution log or explicitly sanitized log
golden, negative, replay and representative-task fixtures used
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.retroactivity_rule: FULL_TEST_EVIDENCE enabled after a completed SUMMARY_ONLY run cannot reconstruct that run. A new authorized run is required; prior commands, logs, environment, fixtures or implementation must not be fabricated.
test_evidence_reproducibility_contract.regulatory_rule: When a valid relevant Governance Specialist or compiled governance requirement identifies a regulatory evidence obligation, recommend air -t on. Missing evidence required for approval, audit preparation, conformity, release or closure routes to REVIEW or EVIDENCE_REQUIRED until qualifying evidence or an authorized equivalent exists.
safety_and_rights_boundary: do not expose hidden reasoning or private chain of thought
do not expose credentials, secrets, restricted source text or unavailable backend logs
make sanitization or redaction and its reproducibility effect visible
do not represent manual, qualitative, model-judged or prompt-side review as deterministic automated execution
the toggle does not prove testing, compliance, audit sufficiency or regulatory conformity

ACTIVE_TASK_CAPABILITY_ENVELOPE.purpose: Compile a task-scoped complete relevant capability envelope and smallest sufficient operative candidate set.

SYNTHETIC_ROLE_AND_EXECUTION_BENCHMARK.purpose: Construct a bounded synthetic role and benchmark that can evaluate the task knowledge-to-execution path without human-status transfer.

DETAILED_DOMAIN_PACKAGE_CONSTRUCTION_OR_.promotion_boundary: Registration as an approved Domain Package requires source validation, representative-task evaluation, explicit approval, versioned identity and Registry-index update.

CAPABILITY_ECOLOGY_PACKAGE_COMPATIBILITY.purpose: Validate component identity, dependency edges, floor compatibility and manifest consistency without binding the package.

validation_contract.claim_scope: Prompt-side, file-backed component validation only. No claim of backend enforcement, external taxonomy correctness, corpus completeness, professional competence, legal compliance, representative-task effectiveness or production readiness. Test evidence is reviewable only to the level of actual preserved definitions, inputs, commands, environment, outputs, logs, fixtures, rights and redaction state. No hidden reasoning or unavailable backend evidence is claimed.

claim_boundary: This Method Pack defines a reusable prompt-side procedure and evidence gates. It does not prove that a model comprehended a domain, executed a task correctly, possesses human experience or professional authority, or passed an external benchmark. Such claims require task-specific observable evidence and applicable qualified review.

amendment_history.approved_scope: Opt-in full test-evidence packages, SUMMARY_ONLY default, CLI-like air -t toggle, post-Q5 recommendation for Q2=C Q3=A Q4=A, regulatory evidence recommendation when Governance is present, no hidden reasoning and no retroactive fabrication.

integration_refresh.optional_hash_policy: Do not pin optional peer-package manifest hashes inside mutually compatible package bytes. Validate exact manifest identity, hash, version, dependencies and task fit at selection time to avoid cyclic hash invalidation.
